key_insights: Crypto markets are stuck in low volatility consolidation with very little native flows - movement is being driven by macro factors (CPI, FOMC) rather than crypto-specific news
Trading into headline-driven events like CPI and FOMC is dangerous due to poor liquidity conditions - spreads widen and order books thin, making fills much worse
Both BTC and ETH are at critical inflection points - BTC range 15.9K-17.6K, ETH stuck at 1.3K resistance with bearish weekly structure
Altcoins are not particularly interesting without a clear directional view on BTC and ETH - correlations are up in the current compressed volatility environment
Best approach is to wait for dust to settle after macro events rather than trading the news release itself, due to increased price of being wrong and poor liquidity
